---
name: Feature Request
about: New engine support, design token change, interactive feature, or workflow improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Use Case

What are you trying to diagram, and why doesn't the current skill handle it well?

## Proposed Change

What should change? Be as specific as you can — engine name, DSL syntax, visual behaviour, etc.

## Engine / Format Involved

Which engine or output format does this touch? (e.g. `d2`, `mermaid`, `erd`, `bpmn`)

## Alternatives Considered

Did you try another engine or workaround? What was wrong with it?
